title: Abstract is 371 words in a single math-dense paragraph, against an IEEE norm of roughly 200
quote: Confidence-weighted self-consistency (CISC and its successors) improves on majority voting when a frozen large language model's self-reported confidence is calibrated in \emph{direction}.
explanation: [Script] The abstract runs 371 words in one paragraph and fills the entire first column of page 1 in the rendered PDF. It also asks the reader to parse inline mathematics before the Introduction begins, including gamma = z*sqrt(2+z^2), kappa = -0.6, D-hat = +0.250 and p = 3.3e-24. The 95-word Conclusion is the mirror defect, and the displaced substance belongs there.

title: Two bibliography entries are never cited
explanation: [Script] kuhn2023semantic and rasc2024 appear as \bibitem entries but no \cite refers to them (26 keys cited, 28 bibitems). IEEE style does not permit uncited entries in the reference list. Both are relevant enough to cite rather than delete: see the semantic-deduplication finding in the prior-art lane.

title: References are not numbered in order of first citation, as IEEE requires
explanation: [Script] First-citation order in the body begins wang2023selfconsistency, tian2023just, xiong2024can, kadavath2022language, taubenfeld2025cisc; the bibliography order is wang2023selfconsistency, taubenfeld2025cisc, aggarwal2023adaptive, li2024escape, kadavath2022language. The first mismatch is at position 2 and the ordering diverges throughout. Reordering the thebibliography block fixes it mechanically.

title: Table II's footnote rows are typeset inside the tabular after \bottomrule
quote: \multicolumn{6}{l}{\footnotesize $^{\dagger}$alarm fires and the method refuses to leave \SC---the conditional}\\
explanation: [Script] Two \multicolumn rows follow \bottomrule inside the tabular environment, so booktabs' trailing rule is no longer the last element and the footnote inherits table-row spacing. Use a tablenotes environment or place the note after \end{tabular}.

title: Six keywords where IEEE asks for three to five
quote: large language models, self-consistency, confidence calibration, weighted voting, label-free estimation, rank statistics
explanation: [Script] The IEEEkeywords block lists six terms. Drop one or two; 'label-free estimation' and 'rank statistics' are the two that most distinguish this paper from its neighbours.

title: Nine pages in IEEEtran conference class, with no named target track
explanation: [Script] The source declares the conference class and renders to 9 pages (body through p. 8, references to p. 9) with 6 tables and 4 figures. Most IEEE conference tracks cap at 6 pages, some at 8 with over-length fees. Until a track with a sufficient limit is named this is a mechanical desk rejection unrelated to merit. Note also the venue-community question: every substantive comparator cited (SC, CISC, adaptive consistency, early-stopping SC, rank calibration) is ACL/EMNLP/ICLR/NeurIPS work, so the reviewers able to adjudicate a van Elteren Somers' D estimator for voting sit in that pool.

title: Citation stacking: nine and six keys in single sentences with no individual characterization
quote: Estimating worker reliability from agreement is classical \cite{dawid1979maximum,whitehill2009whose,karger2011iterative}
explanation: [Script] Related Work carries 20 of the paper's 26 references in 272 words: nine keys in the first paragraph, six in one sentence of the second, four in one sentence of the third. Four works (li2023diverse, borda2025, aggarwal2023adaptive, li2024escape) receive no characterization at all. The section reads as a ledger rather than a synthesis; see the prior-art lane for the substantive consequence.
